reviews.text: The pickleball crew and I started coming last summer, and after being served by Karina and Blake on Mondays and Thursdays we come back every week for them. They are so genuine, put us on chicken nachos, and make sure our urquells are always full! We will continue to come back just for them!

The Local is a trendy place with super friendly servers.  Our server Jackie is attentive and so nice. We were asked at the door where we wanted to sit.  Their patio is like a little hidden gem but we elected to sit inside. The booths inside are huge.  We ordered appetizers to share as it was late on a Sunday.  We had the pork tacos, shrimp dumplings and the peanut chicken satay noodle salad. We did order the potatoe skins but they ran out of that item.  The shrimp dumplings are yummy.  The pork tacos was good but missing a flavour (recommended a slaw to help).  The best dish is the peanut chicken satay noodle salad.  Crunchy, peanuty and limey.  All the flavours to make the salad fresh and tasty.  Overall, a good eatery to try out.  Just note parking is quite limited and the dishes are pricey.

We were at Leaside Pub on Saturday, August 8th, sitting out on the back patio, and I just wanted to leave a special shoutout to our server, Daniel.

The restaurant was really busy when we arrived  Daniel was so warm, friendly & genuinely lovely throughout the entire evening. He was attentive without hovering, checked in with us at all the right moments, and had such a naturally kind and welcoming way about him.

What stood out the most was he never made us feel like JUST another table, even on what was clearly a busy — inside was full and the upstairs was closed for a private party.

Daniel was personable, patient and seemed genuinely happy to be taking care of us. I actually left commenting on how great he was - always a good sign that someone made an impression.

Daniel, thank you for making our night relaxing & enjoyable; Leaside Pub is lucky to have you :)
